title: cordyline zeylanica
intro: Cordyline zeylanica, commonly known as the Ceylon cabbage palm or palm lily, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Cordyline zeylanica include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, which contribute to its use in treating various diseases. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids have been identified in the plant, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
